g1.label: 1. When does shadowing start?
g1.why: The recording says training runs until half past twelve, then shadowing begins.

g2.label: 2. What's not allowed in the kitchen?
g2.why: The recording says sandals are not allowed in the kitchen.

g3.label: 3. How long is the break?
g3.why: The recording says the break is twenty minutes.

g4.label: 4. How to report being late?
g4.why: The recording says to call the café directly if you'll be late.

g5.label: 5. When is payday?
g5.why: The recording says payday is the last Friday of each month.

g6.label: 6. What should Jake learn first?
g6.why: The recording says Jake should learn the till system before his first shift.

g7.label: 7. What discount do staff get?
g7.why: The recording says staff get twenty percent off, but only when not on shift.

g8.label: 8. Who decides shifts?
g8.why: The recording says the manager makes the final decision on the rota.

g1.label: 1. Aisha — talks to people, makes drinks
g1.why: The text says the Barista role involves making coffee and chatting with customers.

g2.label: 2. Noah — shy, works alone
g2.why: The text says the Kitchen Porter role has little contact with customers.

g3.label: 3. Leon — good memory, calm under pressure
g3.why: The text says the Waiter role needs a good memory and a calm attitude.

g4.label: 4. Mia — outdoors, cycling
g4.why: The text says the Delivery Cyclist role involves being outdoors in all weather.

g5.label: 5. Never need to wash hands
g5.why: The text says staff must wash their hands at least every thirty minutes.

g6.label: 6. Phones in the staff room
g6.why: The text confirms phones may be used in the staff room.

g7.label: 7. Free meal on every shift, any length
g7.why: The text says free meals are only for shifts longer than six hours.

g8.label: 8. Open-toe shoes allowed
g8.why: The text says the dress code requires closed-toe shoes.
